# U.S. Food and Drug Administration
> The FDA protects public health by regulating foods, drugs, biologics, medical devices, tobacco products, and related activities in the United States.

The FDA publishes regulatory guidance, safety communications, recalls, approvals, inspections, enforcement actions, and scientific resources for industry, healthcare professionals, researchers, and the public.

## Main FDA Resources
- [FDA Home](https://www.fda.gov/): Main portal for FDA programs, news, safety information, and regulatory resources.
- [About FDA](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda): Overview of FDA organization, mission, leadership, and responsibilities.
- [Contact FDA](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/contact-fda): Contact information for FDA centers, offices, and public inquiries.
- [FDA Organization](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-organization): Organizational structure of FDA centers, offices, and leadership.
- [News & Events](https://www.fda.gov/news-events): FDA announcements, press releases, meetings, and public events.
- [Warning Letters](https://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/compliance-actions-and-activities/warning-letters): Enforcement warning letters issued to regulated entities.

## Drugs
- [Drugs](https://www.fda.gov/drugs): Central hub for human drug regulation, approvals, safety, and compliance.
- [Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER)](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-organization/center-drug-evaluation-and-research-cder): FDA center responsible for regulating human prescription and over-the-counter drugs.
- [Drugs@FDA](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/cder/daf/): Search approved drug products, labeling, approval history, and review documents.
- [Orange Book](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/cder/ob/): Approved drug products with therapeutic equivalence evaluations and patent information.
- [Drug Safety and Availability](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability): Drug safety communications, recalls, shortages, and availability updates.
- [New Drugs at FDA: CDER’s New Molecular Entity and New Therapeutic Biological Product Approvals](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/new-drugs-fda-cders-new-molecular-entity-and-new-therapeutic-biological-product-approvals): Annual summaries of novel drug and therapeutic biologic approvals.
- [Drug Shortages](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability/drug-shortages): Current shortages, discontinuations, and related drug supply information.

## Biologics and Vaccines
- [Biologics](https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics): Hub for vaccines, blood products, cellular therapies, and related biologics.
- [Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER)](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-organization/center-biologics-evaluation-and-research-cber): FDA center regulating vaccines, blood, tissues, and cellular and gene therapies.
- [Vaccines](https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/vaccines): Vaccine regulation, safety, approvals, and policy information.
- [Blood, Blood Products, and Cellular and Gene Therapy Products](https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/blood-blood-products-and-cellular-gene-therapy-products): Regulatory information for blood products and advanced biologic therapies.
- [Tissue, Tissue Products, and Tissue Banking](https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/tissue-tissue-products-and-tissue-banking): Information on human cells, tissues, and tissue-based product regulation.
- [Biologics License Applications (BLA)](https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/development-approval-process-cber/biologics-license-applications-bla-process-cber): Overview of the biologics license application process.

## Medical Devices
- [Medical Devices](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices): Main resource for device regulation, submissions, safety, and compliance.
- [Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH)](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-organization/center-devices-and-radiological-health-cdrh): FDA center regulating medical devices and radiation-emitting products.
- [Device Advice](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/device-advice-comprehensive-regulatory-assistance): Comprehensive educational resource for medical device regulation.
- [Premarket Notification 510(k)](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/premarket-submissions-selecting-and-preparing-correct-submission/premarket-notification-510k): Guidance on preparing and submitting 510(k) device notifications.
- [Premarket Approval (PMA)](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/premarket-submissions/premarket-approval-pma): Requirements and resources for PMA device applications.
- [Medical Device Recalls](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/medical-device-recalls): Recall notices and safety information for medical devices.
- [Medical Device Databases](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/device-advice-comprehensive-regulatory-assistance/medical-device-databases): Links to major FDA device databases and search tools.

## Food
- [Food](https://www.fda.gov/food): Main hub for food safety, labeling, imports, and industry guidance.
- [Center for Food Safety and Applied Nutrition (CFSAN)](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-organization/center-food-safety-and-applied-nutrition-cfsan): FDA center overseeing most food, dietary supplement, and cosmetic regulation.
- [Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA)](https://www.fda.gov/food/guidance-regulation-food-and-dietary-supplements/food-safety-modernization-act-fsma): FSMA rules, guidance, and implementation resources.
- [Food Labeling & Nutrition](https://www.fda.gov/food/food-labeling-nutrition): Labeling requirements, nutrition facts, and claims guidance.
- [Imports & Exports](https://www.fda.gov/food/imports-exports): Food import and export requirements and compliance resources.
- [Recalls, Market Withdrawals, & Safety Alerts](https://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts): Searchable recalls and safety alerts across FDA-regulated products.
- [Constituent Updates](https://www.fda.gov/food/cfsan-constituent-updates): Updates on food policy, guidance, and regulatory actions.

## Tobacco Products
- [Tobacco Products](https://www.fda.gov/tobacco-products): Main hub for tobacco product regulation, compliance, and public health information.
- [Center for Tobacco Products (CTP)](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-organization/center-tobacco-products-ctp): FDA center regulating manufacture, marketing, and distribution of tobacco products.
- [Premarket Tobacco Product Applications](https://www.fda.gov/tobacco-products/market-and-distribute-tobacco-product/premarket-tobacco-product-applications): Requirements for marketing authorization of new tobacco products.
- [Compliance, Enforcement & Training](https://www.fda.gov/tobacco-products/compliance-enforcement-training): Tobacco compliance and enforcement resources for industry and retailers.
- [Rules, Regulations, and Guidance](https://www.fda.gov/tobacco-products/rules-regulations-and-guidance): Tobacco product regulatory requirements and guidance documents.
- [Retail Sales of Tobacco Products](https://www.fda.gov/tobacco-products/retail-sales-tobacco-products): Retailer requirements and youth access restrictions.

## Animal and Veterinary
- [Animal & Veterinary](https://www.fda.gov/animal-veterinary): Main hub for animal drugs, feed, and veterinary regulation.
- [Center for Veterinary Medicine (CVM)](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-organization/center-veterinary-medicine-cvm): FDA center regulating animal drugs, food, and feed safety.
- [Animal Drugs](https://www.fda.gov/animal-veterinary/animal-drugs): Regulatory information on approval and use of animal drugs.
- [Animal Food Feeds](https://www.fda.gov/animal-veterinary/animal-food-feeds): Resources on animal food safety, ingredients, and manufacturing.
- [Veterinary Laboratory Investigation and Response Network (Vet-LIRN)](https://www.fda.gov/animal-veterinary/science-research/veterinary-laboratory-investigation-and-response-network-vet-lirn): Network supporting veterinary diagnostics and outbreak response.
- [Report a Problem with Animal Food](https://www.fda.gov/animal-veterinary/report-problem/report-problem-animal-food): Reporting portal for animal food complaints and safety issues.

## Cosmetics and Radiation-Emitting Products
- [Cosmetics](https://www.fda.gov/cosmetics): Cosmetic safety, labeling, registration, and compliance information.
- [Color Additives and Cosmetics](https://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/cosmetic-products/color-additives-and-cosmetics): Rules and safety information for color additives in cosmetics.
- [MoCRA](https://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/modernization-cosmetics-regulation-act-2022-mocra): Resources on the Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act of 2022.
- [Radiation-Emitting Products](https://www.fda.gov/radiation-emitting-products): Regulation and safety information for radiation-emitting electronic products.
- [Mammography Quality Standards Act (MQSA)](https://www.fda.gov/radiation-emitting-products/mqsa-insights/mammography-quality-standards-act-regulations): Mammography facility standards and regulatory requirements.
- [Laser Products and Instruments](https://www.fda.gov/radiation-emitting-products/home-business-and-entertainment-products/laser-products-and-instruments): Safety and regulatory information for laser products.

## Safety, Recalls, and Adverse Event Reporting
- [Safety](https://www.fda.gov/safety): FDA safety communications, recalls, adverse events, and product alerts.
- [Recalls, Market Withdrawals, & Safety Alerts](https://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts): Search recalls and safety alerts for FDA-regulated products.
- [MedWatch: The FDA Safety Information and Adverse Event Reporting Program](https://www.fda.gov/safety/medwatch-fda-safety-information-and-adverse-event-reporting-program): Safety alerts and adverse event reporting for drugs, devices, and other products.
- [FAERS Public Dashboard](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/questions-and-answers-fdas-adverse-event-reporting-system-faers/fda-adverse-event-reporting-system-faers-public-dashboard): Public dashboard for adverse event reports submitted to FAERS.
- [MAUDE - Manufacturer and User Facility Device Experience](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/cdrh/cfdocs/cfmaude/search.cfm): Search medical device adverse event reports.
- [Reportable Food Registry](https://www.fda.gov/food/compliance-enforcement-food/reportable-food-registry-industry): Mandatory reporting resource for potentially harmful food products.

## Compliance, Inspections, and Enforcement
- [Inspections, Compliance, Enforcement, and Criminal Investigations](https://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations): FDA compliance, inspection, and enforcement resources.
- [Import Program](https://www.fda.gov/industry/import-program-food-and-drug-administration-fda): Overview of FDA import operations and entry review.
- [Import Alerts](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cms_ia/importalert_1.html): Detention without physical examination alerts for imported products.
- [Compliance Actions and Activities](https://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/compliance-actions-and-activities): Enforcement actions, warning letters, injunctions, and related activities.
- [ORA - Office of Regulatory Affairs](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-organization/office-regulatory-affairs): Office leading inspections, imports, and field enforcement operations.
- [Criminal Investigations](https://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/criminal-investigations): Information on FDA criminal investigative authorities and cases.

## Guidance, Regulations, and Submissions
- [Guidance Documents](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents): Search FDA guidance documents across regulated product areas.
- [Federal Register Documents](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/federal-register-documents): FDA rules, proposed rules, and notices published in the Federal Register.
- [Laws Enforced by FDA](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/laws-enforced-fda): Statutes and acts administered or enforced by FDA.
- [Regulatory Information](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information): Central hub for guidance, regulations, and rulemaking resources.
- [Electronic Submissions Gateway](https://www.fda.gov/industry/electronic-submissions-gateway): Secure gateway for transmitting regulatory submissions electronically.
- [FDA Industry Systems](https://www.access.fda.gov/): Portal for registrations, listings, submissions, and industry account management.

## Data, Databases, and Research
- [Databases](https://www.fda.gov/industry/fda-basics-industry/search-fda-guidance-documents-databases): Directory of FDA databases, data tools, and searchable resources.
- [OpenFDA](https://open.fda.gov/): Public APIs for FDA adverse events, labeling, recalls, and enforcement data.
- [Science & Research](https://www.fda.gov/science-research): FDA scientific research programs, laboratories, and methods.
- [Clinical Trials and Human Subject Protection](https://www.fda.gov/science-research/clinical-trials-and-human-subject-protection): Clinical trial oversight and human subject protection resources.
- [National Center for Toxicological Research (NCTR)](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-organization/national-center-toxicological-research): FDA center conducting toxicology and regulatory science research.
- [Data Dashboard](https://www.fda.gov/industry/import-program-food-and-drug-administration-fda/data-dashboard): Dashboard for FDA import and operational data.
